text:
Irene (AM): Heads-up: Cloudline wants to renew but their procurement insists payment comes from a reseller partner (Resellco). Theyre asking for a 30-day net term and reseller invoicing. Deadline EOD Fri.
Jon (CS): reseller pay + net30 is new for this account. any reason for reseller route?
Irene (AM): their procurement says centralized vendor billing for all subsidiaries. Contract signer remains Cloudline GC.
Devon (RevOps): options: a) Accept reseller invoicing + signed reseller agreement and alt-payer amendment OR b) keep Cloudline on PO but allow Resellco to pay with pre-approved reseller addendum. Both require sign-off.
Priya (Legal): Need amendment: name reseller as "Authorized Payer", include clause: "Reseller accepts payment liability only where reseller provided explicit authorization from Cloudline." Also include flow for disputes/chargebacks. I can draft short form.
Mark (Finance): Finance will accept reseller payments if we get: reseller W-9/contract, signed payment authorization from Cloudline, and reseller billing contact. Net30 ok but we require credit check for reseller for terms > 14 days.
Irene (AM): customer timeline: they want provisioning by next Tue. They can provide reseller docs today.
Jon (CS): if reseller path accepted, onboarding scheduling needs a reseller contact for handoff. also confirm whether invoice will be in Resellco name or Cloudline's.
Devon (RevOps): proposed paths to present: 1) Reseller Pay path: amendment + reseller docs + credit check -> proceed, or 2) Direct PO path: Cloudline issues PO, Net0 or Net14, faster clearance.
Priya (Legal): Draft pasted: "Amendment: Cloudline authorizes Resellco (name/email) to pay on its behalf. Resellco confirms authority and accepts limited liability for payments; Cloudline retains responsibility for subscriptions and contractual obligations."
Devon (RevOps): add: "Payment is subject to reseller credit approval; Redwood reserves right to suspend service for nonpayment by authorized payer."
Priya (Legal): added. final version attached.
billing-bot: Invoice preview generated: invoice_2026-1042 preview (amount: $45,600) - https://billing.redwood/invoice/preview/2026-1042
Mark (Finance): will run reseller credit check as soon as we get company details. if credit clear -> approve net30. If not -> request upfront payment or shorter terms.
Irene (AM): sent amendment + reseller checklist to procurement@cloudline. They replied: reseller can provide docs by EOD.
Jon (CS): tagging onboarding risk = "medium" in Gainsight until payment path confirmed.
Mark (Finance): reseller passed soft credit check. were comfortable approving net30 contingent on signed reseller agreement and payment authorization.
Priya (Legal): got signed amendment PDF. saving to contract repo and cc legal@redwood.
Devon (RevOps): created temp payment method "resellco_acct_442" and set manual hold pending final invoice capture.
billing-bot: Temporary payment method created: resellco_acct_442 by Devon. Manual hold applied.
Mark (Finance): final check done. capturing payment on net terms setup. invoice_2026-1042 scheduled, status -> APPROVED PENDING CAPTURE.
Irene (AM): great work. Ill confirm provisioning timeline and close renewal risk -> low after capture.
Jon (CS): updated onboarding plan and assigned reseller onboarding lead.
Irene (AM): thanks team. if any disputes arise, ping me immediately.
